sdg_alignment.description: Assessment of the venture's alignment with UN SDGs.

is_aligned.description: Whether the venture is genuinely aligned with at least one UN SDG.

sdgs_identified.description: List of SDGs the venture aligns with (e.g. 'SDG 9', 'SDG 11').

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of how/why the venture aligns (or doesn't) with the identified SDGs.

kpi_assessment.description: Assessment of whether the venture has defined KPIs for impact measurement.

has_clear_kpis.description: Whether the venture has clearly defined, measurable KPIs for impact.

kpis_identified.description: List of specific KPIs mentioned or implied (e.g. 'number of homes built', 'families housed').

reasoning.description: Explanation of the quality and clarity of the KPIs.

revenue_impact_link.description: Assessment of whether impact grows incrementally with revenue.

impact_grows_with_revenue.description: Degree to which impact scales with revenue: 'significant' = strong direct link, 'potential' = plausible but not proven, 'limited' = weak connection, 'none' = disconnected.

reasoning.description: Explanation of how revenue and impact are linked (or not) in the business model.

score.description: Final IMPACT score from 1 to 5, following the rubric strictly.

score_justification.description: One-sentence summary justifying the final score.
